uatRuntimeDisposition.statement: As of this register, the HN-UAT-003 / WWHN-78 UAT chain (WWHN-76, WWHN-286, WWHN-288) has published ZERO runtime defect rows in Jira. HN-UAT-003 is not defined inside the 4 controlling docs (verified by full-text search); UAT evidence is downstream Jira per SRS L142 (SRS chỉ chứa BA-level AC/TC design) and SRS L152 (DS-EVD-001 downstream). This register therefore enumerates every REAL defect identified by the WWHN-292 review chain itself, each with before -> fix SHA/files -> after -> retest. A zero-UAT-runtime-defect disposition for the parent chain requires the BA/QA sign-off comment recorded on WWHN-292; it is approved by that comment, not fabricated here.

defects.moduleRoute: authenticated application shell (aside/header/content) - all module screens
defects.expected: Responsive claim 'shell/login' must be proven on the authenticated shell: no horizontal overflow at every required viewport; wireframe shell contract - fixed 300px aside with 300px main offset above 980px, static full-width aside at <=980px (Wireframe L13 grid 300px, L51 @media max-width:980px; desktop minimum 1280px per NFR-SRS-006 SRS L593).

defects.afterEvidence: 4 authenticated-shell tests (one per viewport) asserting hasHorizontalOverflow=false + aside position/width/offset contract; constants 1280/980/300 locked by verifier so drift fails the gate.

defects.expected: Route-level fail-closed must hold on EVERY protected route (default deny, SRS L532 enforcement standard; UI hiding is not authorization, SRS L296/L582; FE = UX gate, Techstack L494): direct URL -> /errors/403 + explicit no-permission state + hidden menu entry; plus a positive control proving the guard does not over-block granted permissions.

defects.controllingSource: SRS L532 (default deny) + SRS L296 + SRS L582 + SRS L1390-1458 (Annex C route->permission) + Techstack L489-494 (RequirePermission; FE la UX gate)
